entities.summary: Daniel Wells Jr. was an American businessman, Democratic politician, and Wisconsin pioneer. He was a major contributor to the early economic development of the city of Milwaukee, and was critical to the establishment of the Milwaukee–St. Paul Railroad. He was the wealthiest man in Wisconsin at the time of his death; he is the namesake of the Wells Building and Wells Street in Milwaukee.
